title: Inversion and Emphasis / Isbeddel iyo Xujid
bridge: Faransiiska, inaanu u adeegno inta badan dhaqanka ama ku darnaa erayad sidee 'sí que' ama 'es que', laakiin Ingiriishi, xujidda waxay ku tashan tahay isbeddelka midka ag-fariinta ama isticmaalka xogta u muhiimsan oo 'not only... but also' ama 'so + adjective... that'. Waxaana u eg yahay inaanu u adag noqono inaanu u fahmo dhaqanka Soomali, maxaa yeelay isbeddelka Faransiiska ma aha mid caan ah, isaga markaa u dhexeeyo su'aalo ama hal qoto dheer. Khilaafad caan ah waa in la isticmaalo midka ag-fariinta Ingiriishi markii loo baahnayo isbeddel, oo loo soo bixiyo erayad khalad ah oo 'Not only he arrived late' kala duwan 'Not only did he arrive late'.
rule: Isbeddelka Ingiriishi waxay u adeegtaa in la xujiyo ama in la isticmaalo dhaqan rasmi ah. Waxay noqotaa qaybooyinka kuwanu: 1) Dabadeed wixii ku jira erayad adag oo kala duwan 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'no sooner', 'not only', 'not until', 'little', 'in no way'. Qaybooyinkanu, wixii ka socda waa in la isbeddelo wixii ka socda (do/does/did, have/has, will, iwm.) oo la soo bixiyo horayska ag-fariinta, oo wixii u dhexeeya waa in la isticmaalo midka ag-fariinta oo aan 'to' lahayn. Misal: 'Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.' 2) 'So + adjective/adverb' iyo 'such + noun' bilowga erayada, in la soo bixiyo natiijo ama sabab, oo la dheereyso 'that' (haddii 'that' ayay noqon doontaa): 'So beautiful was the painting that everyone stared.' 3) In la soo bixiyo kala duwan 'not only... but also', 'only after', 'only if', iwm. 4) Xogta u muhiimsan oo ay leedahay 'if' oo aan la isticmaalin: 'Had I known, I would have come.' 5) 'Here' iyo 'there' markii wixii u dhexeeya waa mid aan fariin lahayn oo ag-fariintu waa magac, aan ahayn adag. 6) Erayad oo ay leedahay 'may' (rasmi ah). Muhiim: Ingiriishi ma isticmaali jirin isbeddelka erayad oo ay leedahay (kala duwan Faransiiska qaybooyinka su'aalo ama erayad oo ay leedahay), oo ma laha in la khalgalo in la sameeyo su'aalo. Ha u untoona in isbeddelka erayad adag oo ay leedahay waa in la isticmaalo wixii ka socda, haddii ay adag u ahayd wixii u dhexeeya.

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered such a challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Sii aan u jeedinay mushkil adag oo aan u adagayn.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntərd sʌtʃ ə ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Not only did she lose her job, but she also had to relocate.
concept_examples.translation: Aan u adagayn inuu ku dhaqan qofka, laakiin wuu ku dhaqan qofka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː luːz hɜː dʒɒb bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæd tə ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt/

concept_examples.text: So intense was the heat that the roads began to melt.
concept_examples.translation: Sii aan u adagayn inuu ku dhaqan qofka, waxaa bilaabay inuu ku dhaqan qofka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /səʊ ɪnˈtens wɒz ðə hiːt ðæt ðə rəʊdz bɪˈɡæn tə melt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the war did the country experience true reconstruction.
concept_examples.translation: Sii aan u adagayn inuu ku dhaqan qofka, waxaa bilaabay inuu ku dhaqan qofka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈəʊnli ˈæftə ðə wɔː dɪd ðə ˈkʌntri ɪkˈspɪəriəns truː ˌriːkənˈstrʌkʃən/

common_error.wrong: Not only he has a beautiful voice, but also he sings well.
common_error.correct: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.correct_alt: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.explanation: Khalaafadu wuu noqotaa maxaa yeelay Faransiiska waxaynu odhan lahaa 'No solo él tiene una voz hermosa, sino que además canta bien', oo aan la isticmaalin midka ag-fariinta. Ingiriishi, markii ay bilowgii erayada 'not only', waa in la isbeddelo wixii ka socda ag-fariinta. Hadana waa in la isticmaalo wixii ka socda 'does' bilowga aad u dhakhsaha badan, oo wixii u dhexeeya 'have' waa in la isticmaalo midka ag-fariinta. Waxaa caan ah in la iska darayo isbeddelka erayad Faransiiska. In aad u dhaqso khalaafadu, xusuuso in dabadeed 'not only', 'never', 'rarely', iwm., midka ag-fariinta waa in la soo bixiyo: wixii ka socda + ag-fariinta + midka ag-fariinta.

examples.original: Never have I seen such a dedicated team.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈdɛdɪkeɪtɪd tiːm/
examples.translation: Sii aan u jeedinay shirkad adag oo aan u adagayn.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'never' bilowga oo isbeddelka 'have' iyo 'I'. Faransiiska ma isbeddelin, waxaynu odhan lahaa 'Nunca he visto'.

examples.original: Rarely do we find such an honest politician.
examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː faɪnd sʌtʃ ən ˈɒnɪst ˌpɒlɪˈtɪʃən/
examples.translation: Raraa ayanu helnay siyaasad adag oo aan u adagayn.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'rarely', waa in la isticmaalo 'do' oo ah wixii ka socda bilowga aad u dhakhsaha badan, oo wixii u dhexeeya 'find' waa in la isticmaalo midka ag-fariinta.

examples.original: Hardly had we left the house when it started to rain.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli hæd wiː lɛft ðə haʊs wɛn ɪt ˈstɑːtɪd tə reɪn/
examples.translation: Sii aan u jeedinay inaanu ka baxnay guriga, ayaa bilaabay inuu bilaabo roobka.
examples.note: Xogta 'hardly... when' waxay u muhiimsan tahay in waxay noqotay si toos ah dabadeed wax kale. Waa in la isticmaalo bilowga aad u dhakhsaha badan oo isbeddelka.

examples.original: So tired was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈtaɪəd wɒz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Sii aan u adagayn inay ku dhaqan qofka, waxaa bilaabay inay ku dhaqan qofka.
examples.note: Xogta 'so + adjective + was/were + ag-fariinta + that' waxay u adeegtaa in la xujiyo dheege adag. Faransiiska, waxaynu isticmaalino 'tan... que' oo aan isbeddel lahayn.

examples.original: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt ˈnəʊbədi kʊd sliːp/
examples.translation: Sii aan u adagayn inuu ku dhaqan qofka, waxaa bilaabay inuu ku dhaqan qofka.
examples.note: Waa in la isticmaalo 'such' oo la dheereyso magac bilowga in la xujiyo. Halkan, 'such' waxay u adeegtaa midka ag-fariinta, oo wixii u dhexeeya 'was' waa in la soo bixiyo horayska ag-fariinta.

examples.original: So quickly did she finish that everyone was amazed.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈkwɪkli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðæt ˈɛvrɪwʌn wɒz əˈmeɪzd/
examples.translation: Sii aan u adagayn inay ku dhaqan qofka, waxaa bilaabay inay ku dhaqan qofka.
examples.note: Markii la isticmaalo adag ('quickly') kala duwan midka ag-fariinta, waa in la isticmaalo wixii ka socda 'did' oo la dheereyso midka ag-fariinta oo aan 'to' lahayn.

levels.label: Conditional Inversion and Formal Structures
levels.translation: Isbeddel xogta u muhiimsan iyo xogta rasmi ah

examples.original: Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ nəʊn əˈbaʊt ðə dɪˈleɪ aɪ wʊd hæv lɛft ˈɜːliə/
examples.translation: Haddii aan ogayn waxa ku saabsan kharashka, waxaan bilaabay inaan ka baxno horay.
examples.note: Xogta u muhiimsan, waa in la iska darayo 'if' oo la isbeddelo ag-fariinta 'had'. Waxay u eg tahay 'If I had known...'.

examples.original: Should you need any assistance, do not hesitate to call us.
examples.phonetic: /ʃʊd juː niːd ˈɛni əˈsɪstəns duː nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə kɔːl ʌs/
examples.translation: Haddii aad baahan doontid caawimad, ha u ogolaan inaad nala soo xiriirto.
examples.note: Isticmaalka isbeddelka 'should' kala duwan 'if' in la helmo dhaqan rasmi ah. Faransiiska, waxaynu isticmaalino 'si aad u baahan doontid'.

examples.original: No sooner had the concert started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈkɒnsət ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Sii aan u jeedinay inuu bilaabo konsat-dhibic, ayaa bilaabay inuu bilaabo roobka.
examples.note: 'No sooner... than' waxay u muhiimsan tahay in waxay noqotay si toos ah dabadeed wax kale, oo isbeddelka bilowga aad u dhakhsaha badan.

examples.original: Were the government to propose such a law, it would be highly controversial.
examples.phonetic: /wɜː ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt tə prəˈpəʊz sʌtʃ ə lɔː ɪt wʊd biː ˈhaɪli ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃəl/
examples.translation: Haddii dowladda ayay soo bandhigaysay sharc aan la hulmaysan, waxayno qaban lahaa inay ahaan lahaa khilaafad adag.
examples.note: Xogta u muhiimsan oo ay leedahay 'were + ag-fariinta + to + midka ag-fariinta' oo ah badal 'if + past simple'.

translations.so: Sintaxis advanced iyo xogta u muhiimsan

title: Register and Style: Formal, Informal, and Neutral / Qoraal iyo Xoog: Rasmi, aan rasmi ahyn, iyo adag
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa in badan la isticmaalayo 'aad'/'waa', laakiin Af-Ingiriisiga, isbedelka qoraalka u muujisaa erayada, qaybaha sintaksis, iyo sawirro cusub oo kalena. Khalad caadi ah waa in la soo baxayo rasmiinta erayada oo kala duwan oo Af-Ingiriisiga ku qallafsan yihiin ama ku xumaan yihiin. Misaal, 'Waxaan kuu qorayaa si aan ku baryo...' waa rasmi, laakiin 'Waxaan kuu qorayaa si aan ku weydiiyo...' waa adag oo ku habboon tahay si toos ah ee adeegsanayaasha. Waxa ugu muhiimsan waa in la ogaado qaybihii qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa ilaa aan la eachaloto tarjumaadka midka mid.
rule: Af-Ingiriisiga C1, qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa kala duwan yahay: abuurka (e.g., 'get' vs 'obtain', 'show' vs 'demonstrate'), qaybihii sintaksis (isticmaalka qaybihii aan la isticmalin, qaybihii qaybta, iyo shartiyada) iyo sawirro cusub (qaybihii heshaynta, qaybihii qaybta). Qoraalka rasmi ah ayuu u adeegsan yahay qoraallada xaqiiqa ah, barashadaha rasmi ah, iyo warbixinta; ayuu ku jira qaybihii aan la isticmalin ('It was decided...'), erayada Laatiinka, iyo jumbalada qaybihii qaybta ('furthermore', 'nevertheless'). Qoraalka aan rasmi ahayn ayuu muujisaa hadalka maalinle ah, barashadaha dhexdhexaad ah; ayuu isticmaalaya qaybihii qaybta, erayada (e.g., 'put off' in 'postpone'), iyo erayada culus. Qoraalka adag ayuu u fiican yahay qoraallada badan oo aan xusuusanayn: qalalan, toos, iyo aan jargo ahayn. C1, waa muhiim in la ogaado goormay isticmaalo midkood iyo in la diido isbedelka qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa.

concept_examples.text: I would be grateful if you could provide me with further details.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan kugu mahadsanahay haddii aad ii soo dirto macluumaadka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfʊl ɪf juː kʊd prəˈvaɪd miː wɪð ˈfɜːðər ˈdiːteɪlz/

concept_examples.text: Could you send me the report by Friday?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad ii soo dirin warbaahintii ilaa Jimcaha?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː sɛnd miː ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: No worries, I'll get back to you later.
concept_examples.translation: Ha ka tag, waxaan kuu soo dhaweeyaa ilaa dushooda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈwʌriz aɪl ɡɛt bæk tə juː ˈleɪtər/

common_error.wrong: I am writing this in order to ask you for a favor, because I need to know if you can help me with the presentation.
common_error.correct: I'm writing to ask a favor – could you help me with the presentation?
common_error.correct_alt: I'm writing to ask you a favor: would you be able to help me with the presentation?
common_error.explanation: Khaladkuu u muujisaa maxaa yeelay Af-Soomaaliga ayay u jeedaan inay isugu dhejiyaan qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa: ayay bilaabeen inay bilaabeen 'Waxaan kuu qorayaa si aan ku baryo' kadibna ayay isugu dhejiyaan qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa adag/aan rasmi ahayn ('maxaa yeelay waan u baahanahay inaan ogaado'). Af-Ingiriisiga, waa fiican in la doorto qoraal qaabka u muujisaa. Si aad u hesho adeegsanayaasha laakiin adag, isticmaala qaybihii qaybta iyo qaybihii qaybta; si aad u hesho mid rasmi ah, iska ilaa qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa 'Waxaan kuu qorayaa si aan ku baryo' iyo jerin qaybihii qaybta. Isugu dhejiinta ayuu ku qallafsan yahay si aan u adag ahayn.

examples.original: The company has decided to implement a new policy.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni hæz dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɪmplɪmɛnt ə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Shirkaddu way tashadeeday inay soo bandhigto siyaasad cusub.
examples.note: Isticmaalka qaybihii aan la isticmalin si ay u fiicisin tusaaleha iyo aan la isticmalin. Waxa ay tahay mid ka mid ah qoraallada rasmi ah.

examples.original: We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
examples.phonetic: /wiː rɪˈɡrɛt tʊ ɪnˈfɔːm juː ðæt jɔːr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən hæz biːn ˌʌnsəkˈsɛsfəl/
examples.translation: Waxaan kugu xumaanahay inaan kuu sheego in baabuurtaadu ma ay noqotin.
examples.note: Qaybihii heshaynta ee ugu dhaqan yahay barashadaha rasmi ah. Fiir qaybihii qaybta ('has been' in 'hasn't').

examples.original: Would you be so kind as to sign the attached document?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː səʊ kaɪnd æz tə saɪn ði əˈtætʃt ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
examples.translation: Ma ayad ii oggolaan inaad qaaddo warbixinta la xiriiray?
examples.note: Qaybihii heshaynta oo aan xumbahnayn. Af-Soomaaliga ayannu isticmaalaynaa 'aad', halqabta 'would you be so kind' ayuu u fiicayaa rasmiinta.

examples.original: Please send me the updated version of the file.
examples.phonetic: /pliːz sɛnd miː ði ˌʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈvɜːʃən əv ðə faɪl/
examples.translation: Fadlan, ii soo dir warbixinta ugu horreysay.
examples.note: Adag: qalalan iyo toos, laakiin aan culus ahayn. Aan isticmaalayn qaybihii qaybta ama erayada xirfad leh.

examples.original: I'll forward you the details as soon as I get them.
examples.phonetic: /aɪl ˈfɔːwərd juː ðə ˈdiːteɪlz æz suːn æz aɪ ɡɛt ðɛm/
examples.translation: Waxaan kuu soo dirayaa macluumaadka marka aan soo helayo.
examples.note: Isticmaalka qaybihii qaybta ('I'll') iyo erayada ('get them' in 'obtain'), laakiin aan culus ahayn.

examples.original: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæz biːn pəʊstˈpəʊnd ənˈtɪl nɛkst wiːk/
examples.translation: Warbixinta ayay la xilafeen ilaa toddobaadka ee dambe.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'postponed' (kuwaas oo ka badan 'put off') laakiin qaybihii aan la isticmalin, ugu dhaqan yahay qoraallada adag.

examples.original: Wanna grab a coffee later?
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɒnə ɡræb ə ˈkɒfi ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: Ma ayad jeclaan inaad ka dhigo qaxootiga ilaa dushooda?
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'wanna' (qaybihii culus ee 'want to') iyo 'grab' (qab) in 'have'. Culus aad u badan.

examples.original: I can't make it to the party tonight, sorry!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kɑːnt meɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈpɑːti təˈnaɪt ˈsɒri/
examples.translation: Ma aan u geli karo dhaqanka biyeelka, waxaan kugu dhaqmaa!
examples.note: Qaybihii qaybta 'can't', erayada 'make it' (in la heli karo), iyo 'sorry' si loo qalad qaybihii qaybta.

examples.original: That's a really cool idea, let's do that!
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈrɪəli kuːl aɪˈdɪə lɛts duː ðæt/
examples.translation: Tanu waa fikrad wanaagsan, aan sameeyno!
examples.note: Adjectives culus 'cool' in 'excellent' ama 'good'. Isbedelka iyo qaybihii qaybta ayay ku fiicisin tahay qoraalka qaabka u muujisaa.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Inversion iyo Fronting ka yar
bridge: Ingiriishi, inversion (in oo ku noqotaa qalbka caawimaadka oo ka hor jeeda isaga) ayuu u adeegsan yahay si aan u qayb galno qiyaastii, laakiin ayuu u adeegsan yahay si loo xanjanno ama si loo noqoto furan. Af-Soomaaliga, waxaan ku dhigan nahay xanjin ka badan oo ku salaysan qiyaastii ama si loo beddelo qalabka isaga-qalbiga. Misaal, 'Rarely have I seen such beauty' ayuu noqon lahaa 'Rarely I have seen such beauty' Af-Soomaaliga, oo aan inversion ku jirin. Khilaafkii ugu weyn ee ah waa in Af-Soomaaliga inversion ayay ku dhacdo qiyaastii oo xilli ah, ingiriishi-na ayay ku noqoto dhaqanka oo ku salaysan erayada xumaan ama erayada xadgudub. Fiir: ha u beddelin erayada xumaan oo dhan oo ku dhex jira, laakiin keliya erayada oo u ogolaan.
rule: Ingiriishi, inversion ayay ku dhacdo markii erayada xumaan (adverbs), erayada xadgudub, ama erayada tiimiga oo ku salaysan xumaan ayay ku noqotan hor dhaqanka. Haddan, qalbiga caawimaadka (ama qalbiga 'be') ayuu ku noqotaa isaga oo ka hor jeeda, oo ku salaysan qalabka qiyaastii. Qalabka ugu dhexeen waxay ku jiraan: 1) Erayada xumaan: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'barely', 'no sooner' - misaal: 'Never have I seen such a mess'. 2) Erayada xadgudub: 'not only...but also', 'only after', 'only by', 'only when' - misaal: 'Only after the war did they return'. 3) Erayada tiimiga oo ku salaysan 'so' ama 'such' - misaal: 'So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped'. 4) Erayada 'not until' ama 'not since' - misaal: 'Not until midnight did the party end'. 5) Erayada 'in no way', 'on no account', 'under no circumstances'. Xusuuso haddii aynu qalbiga caawimaadka aanay jirin, isticmaal 'do/does/did' si aad u hesho inversion ee muddada hadda iyo dhibicda. Inversionkan waa mid oo ku salaysan dhaqanka furan iyo dhaqanka qora; hadalka adeegsan waa mid ka yar, laakiin ayuu ku noqotaa hadalka xanjin.

concept_examples.text: Never have I seen such a magnificent sunset.
concept_examples.translation: Sii aan u arinay qiiqa shanad u dhexeeyay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt ˈsʌnsɛt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the meeting did she realize her mistake.
concept_examples.translation: Keliya daraaddooda shirka ayay ogaadeen khaladkooda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ dɪd ʃiː ˈriːəlaɪz hɜːr mɪˈsteɪk/

concept_examples.text: Not only did he finish the race, but he also broke the record.
concept_examples.translation: Aan keliya u dhammayn tafaqomta, laakiin ayuu ku darbaxay record-ka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈoʊnli dɪd hiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə reɪs bʌt hiː ˈɔːlsoʊ broʊk ðə ˈrɛkərd/

concept_examples.text: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
concept_examples.translation: Qaybta aan lahaano xaaladda ha furto billaabkaas.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndər noʊ ˈsɜːrkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈoʊpən ðæt dɔːr/

common_error.wrong: Rarely I have seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct: Rarely have I seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct_alt: I have rarely seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.explanation: Khalaafka waxay ku dhacdaa maxaa yeelay Af-Soomaaliga ma nuso ogin isaga iyo qalbiga qiyaastii oo ku salaysan erayada xumaan oo ku dhex jira. Markii aad u beddelto 'Rarely I have seen' si aan u qayb galno, waxaad u unaxaysaa inversion. Xusuuso: markii erayada xumaan ama erayada tiimiga oo ku salaysan xumaan ayay ku noqotan hor dhaqanka ingiriishi, waa inaad u beddelto qalbiga caawimaadka iyo isaga, isticmaal 'do/does/did' haddii qalbiga caawimaadka aanay jirin. Haddii aad doonaysid inaad u daahirin inversion, waxaad u qorin karisaa erayada xumaan ee ku dhex jira (oo ka dib qalbiga caawimaadka) iyo aanay u beddelin.

examples.original: Never had she felt so alone.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæd ʃiː fɛlt soʊ əˈloʊn/
examples.translation: Sii aan u arinay inayay u dhaqmaynay si aan u adag.
examples.note: Isticmaashada 'never' oo ku dhex jira dhibicda, oo ku beddela 'had' iyo isaga.

examples.original: Rarely do we see such dedication.
examples.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdɛdɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Rarely we see such dedication.
examples.note: Muddada hadda, isticmaalo 'do' si aad u hesho inversion.

examples.original: Hardly had the play started when the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːrdli hæd ðə pleɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd wɛn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːrm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Hardly had the play begun when the fire alarm went off.
examples.note: Qalabka 'hardly...when' waxay u baahan yahay inversion qaybta ugu horreeya, oo badan ayay isticmaalata dhibicda.

examples.original: Only by working hard can you achieve your goals.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli baɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ hɑːrd kæn juː əˈtʃiːv jɔːr ɡoʊlz/
examples.translation: Keliya oo la shaqeynayo si adag ayad u heshiin cadaaladaada.
examples.note: Erayada 'only by' + gerund, inversion ayay ku dhacdo qaybta ugu weyn.

examples.original: Not until midnight did the storm subside.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ənˈtɪl ˈmɪdnaɪt dɪd ðə stɔːrm səbˈsaɪd/
examples.translation: Aan ahayn ilaa dhexdeeda ayay abaad u dhaqmaynay.
examples.note: Erayada 'not until', inversion ayay ku dhacdo qaybta ugu weyn, aan qaybta xadhigga ahayn.

examples.original: Only when the last tree is cut down will we realize its importance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ðə lɑːst triː ɪz kʌt daʊn wɪl wiː ˈriːəlaɪz ɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtəns/
examples.translation: Keliya markii la qaado geedka ugu dambay ayay nu oofin doonaa arrimahaasa.
examples.note: Fiiri in inversion ayay ku dhacdo qaybta ugu weyn, aan qaybta xadhigga ahayn oo ku salaysan 'when'.

examples.original: So exhausted was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /soʊ ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd wʌz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Sidaa ayay u adagsantahay ayay u nadiifay si aan u adag.
examples.note: Inversion oo ku salaysan 'so + adjective' oo ku dhex jira ayay u noqotaan xanjin u leh.

examples.original: Such was the chaos that no one could hear the announcement.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wʌz ðə ˈkeɪɒs ðæt noʊ wʌn kʊd hɪər ði əˈnaʊnsmənt/
examples.translation: Sidaa ayay u dhexdhacay ayay aan lahayn in la maqlo furaha.
examples.note: 'Such' + qalbiga + erayada; inversion ayay ku dhacdo qalbiga 'be'.

examples.original: That film I would never watch again.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt fɪlm aɪ wʊd ˈnɛvər wɒtʃ əˈɡɛn/
examples.translation: Filmkaas ma ayay ku noqon doontay inay mar kale arkaan.
examples.note: Fronting oo aan inversion ku jirin: waxaad u hor dhigtaa erayada si aad u xanjiso, laakiin qalabka isaga-qalbiga ayay ku hadhashaa.

title: Complex Nominalization (process → processing) / Isku-ururinta Nominaalka (wareegsan → isku-ururinta)
bridge: Faransiiska, isku-ururinta fariin ku noqda inay qoraan tahay waxaad u adeegsan tahay lafaha -ción, -miento ama isku-ururinta (misaalka procesar → procesamiento). Laakiin, Ingiriishiinta waxay adeegsan yihiin dhammaan lafaha -ing (gerundio) oo ah qoraal, oo Faransiiska badan oo kale waxay u tarjumaya qoraal ama qoraal la soo saaray. Khilaafkii ugu weyn ee ah waa in Ingiriishiinta gerundio wuxuu u noqda inuu yahay isagoo, calaamad ama hadal, waxaase Faransiiska isku-ururinta waxay u fiicnaan tahay inay u noqoto. Sidaa darteed, Ingiriishiinta waxay u dhexeeyaan qoraalka isku-ururinta iyo qoraalka iyo hadalka oo u dhexeeyey (misaalka "data processing speed"), waxaase Faransiiska waa inay u furaan. Fiirista sidaa darteed khilaafkii oo dhan ee gerundio oo ah qoraal (the processing) iyo mid ka mid ah (the processing plant), waxaase u eg yahay inay noqoto.
rule: Ingiriishiinta, isku-ururinta badan oo kale waxay u noqda inay noqoto wareegsan, shuqul ama xaalad oo ay qoraan tahay, oo ay adeegsan yihiin ugu badnaa gerundio (-ing) iyo, kuwa ka yar, lafaha -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity ama -al. Gerundio isku-ururinta waxay leedahay waxyaalahaas: (1) isagoo: "Processing data requires time"; (2) calaamad: "I enjoy processing information"; (3) hadal: "She is responsible for processing orders"; (4) hadal: "a processing plant". Qalabka iyo akhbarada (C1), isku-ururinta waxay u adeegsan yihiin inay u noqoto: "The processing of sensitive data is regulated" oo ka badan "You must process sensitive data in a regulated way". Wareegsan oo ah, Ingiriishiinta waxay u jeclaan yihiin gerundio (the processing) waxaase waxay u adeegsan yihiin qoraal la soo saaray (the processing, the analysis, the development). Khilaafyo: fariin oo ay leedahay qoraal (to decide → decision, to explain → explanation) iyo ma ay oggolaan -ing isku-ururinta (ma ay leedahay "the deciding" qalabka). Sidaa darteed, waxay leedahay isku-ururinta aan la isku dhigo (to grow → growth, to lose → loss, to choose → choice). Hadalka, gerundio wuxuu u noqda inuu yahay qoraal (processing unit) ama wuxuu u noqda inuu yahay qoraal (data processing). Gerundio hadalka, wuxuu u noqda inuu yahay 'of': "the processing of data" waxay u fiican tahay "data processing" qalabka. Faransiiska, tarjumadahaas waxay u fiican yihiin isku-ururinta: "procesar datos" ama qoraal la soo saaray: "el procesamiento de datos".

concept_examples.text: The processing of personal data requires strict security measures.
concept_examples.translation: Isku-ururinta macluumaadka shakhsiya waxay u baahan tahay xog taageerada xumaysan.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈprəʊsɛsɪŋ əv ˈpɜːsənl ˈdeɪtə rɪˈkwaɪəz strɪkt sɪˈkjʊərəti ˈmɛʒəz

concept_examples.text: Her writing demonstrates a deep understanding of complex issues.
concept_examples.translation: Qoraalka uu soo bixiyey waxay bogsiiyaa fahamka badan oo dhan oo dhan oo dhan.

concept_examples.text: The rapid growth of the economy surprised many analysts.
concept_examples.translation: Dejinta degdeggan ee iibka waxay ku halaysiiyay sharciyayaasha badan.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈræpɪd grəʊθ əv ði ɪˈkɒnəmi səˈpraɪzd ˈmɛni ˈænəlɪsts

concept_examples.text: Effective decision-making in crisis situations is a key leadership skill.
concept_examples.translation: Doorashada fiican ee xalaaladii waxay u baahan tahay awooda ugu weyn ee talada.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪˈfɛktɪv dɪˈsɪʒənˌmeɪkɪŋ ɪn ˈkraɪsɪs ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃənz ɪz ə kiː ˈliːdəʃɪp skɪl

common_error.wrong: The deciding of the final result was difficult.
common_error.correct: The decision on the final result was difficult.
common_error.correct_alt: Deciding the final result was difficult.
common_error.explanation: Khalaafka waxay noqotay maxaa yeelay ku dhawaad wuxuu u adeegsan yahay gerundio -ing oo isku-ururinta si ay u noqoto inay u noqoto fariin, oo la xiriiray isku-ururinta Faransiiska ("el decidir"). Laakiin, Ingiriishiinta, markii fariinka ay leedahay qoraal la soo saaray (decide → decision), waxay u fiican yihiin inay u adeegsan yihiin qoraalkaas qalabka. Isticmaalka "the deciding" oo ah isagoo waxay ku dhaxaysa inay noqoto, ilaa iibka "the deciding factor". In ay u daayaan, waa in la diyaariyo qoraalka la soo saaray aan la isku dhigo iyo in la isticmaalo gerundio markii aan jirin qoraal ama markii ay u baahan yihiin inay u noqoto. Qalabkaan, ama waa in la isticmaalo "decision" (natiijo) ama waa in la soo baxayo gerundio oo ah isagoo: "Deciding the final result was difficult" (wareegsan).

examples.original: Learning a new language enhances cognitive abilities.
examples.phonetic: ˈlɜːnɪŋ ə njuː ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ɪnˈhɑːnsɪz kɒɡˈnɪtɪv əˈbɪlɪtiz
examples.translation: Fahamka luqad cusub waxay u badbaadisan tahay awooda fahamka.
examples.note: Faransiiska waxay u adeegsan yihiin isku-ururinta ('aprender') oo ah isagoo; Ingiriishiinta waxay u adeegsan yihiin gerundio ('learning'). Kana waa khilaafka ugu weyn.

examples.original: Analyzing data is essential for scientific research.
examples.phonetic: ˈænəlaɪzɪŋ ˈdeɪtə ɪz ɪˈsɛnʃəl fɔː ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk rɪˈsɜːtʃ
examples.translation: Fahamka macluumaad waxay u baahan tahay tijaabada ekaanka.
examples.note: Eeg sidii gerundio ay u dhexeeyaan calaamadda ('data') oo u dhexeeyey, aan la soo saarin, sida Faransiiska isku-ururinta.

examples.original: Dealing with ambiguity is a skill that improves over time.

examples.translation: Doorashada xalaaladii waxay u baahan tahay awooda inay u badbaadiso xaaladda.
examples.note: Gerundio 'dealing' waxay u baahan tahay hadalka 'with' oo ah qayb ka mid ah hadalka 'deal with'; Faransiiska waxay u adeegsan yihiin 'lidiar con'.

levels.label: Gerund as Object and After Prepositions
levels.translation: Gerundio oo ah calaamad iyo hadal

examples.original: She avoided making a decision until the last minute.
examples.phonetic: ʃiː əˈvɔɪdɪd ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə dɪˈsɪʒən ʌnˈtɪl ðə lɑːst ˈmɪnɪt
examples.translation: Ayay diiday inay dooran doorashada ilaa waqtiga ugu dambeeyey.
examples.note: Fariinka 'avoid' waxay u baahan tahay gerundio ka dib; Faransiiska waxay u adeegsan yihiin isku-ururinta ('tomar'). Waa in la diyaariyo fariimahaas.

examples.original: We are committed to improving our processes.
examples.phonetic: wiː ɑː kəˈmɪtɪd tuː ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ aʊə ˈprəʊsɛsɪz
examples.translation: Waxay nala shaqaynaysaa inay u fiicnaan wareeggaheen.
examples.note: Ka dib hadalka 'to' (oo ah qayb ka mid ah 'be committed to'), waxay u adeegsan yihiin gerundio, aan isku-ururinta. Faransiiska waxay u dhaqmayaan isku-ururinta.

examples.original: The success of the project depends on planning carefully.
examples.phonetic: ðə səkˈsɛs əv ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt dɪˈpɛndz ɒn ˈplænɪŋ ˈkeəfəli
examples.translation: Nijaanka shaqaalaha waxay u dhexeeyaan doorashada fiican.
examples.note: Ka dib hadalka 'on' (depend on) waxay u adeegsan yihiin gerundio. Daawi'i khaladka isticmaalka 'to plan'; qalabka waxay 'depend on + -ing'.

levels.label: Nominal Compounds and Abstract Suffixes
levels.translation: Qoraal la soo saaray iyo lafaha qoraalka

examples.original: The decision-making process was slow and bureaucratic.
examples.phonetic: ðə dɪˈsɪʒənˌmeɪkɪŋ ˈprəʊsɛs wɒz sləʊ ænd ˌbjʊərəˈkrætɪk
examples.translation: Wareegga doorashada doorashada waxay ahaayeen adag iyo buuroocraasi.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'decision-making' waxay u dhexeeyaan qoraal iyo gerundio; Faransiiska waxay u furaan 'toma de decisiones'.

examples.original: Improving the company's efficiency was the main objective.
examples.phonetic: ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ ðə ˈkʌmpəniz ɪˈfɪʃənsi wɒz ðə meɪn əbˈdʒɛktɪv
examples.translation: Fiicinta fiicinta shaqaalaha waxay ahaayeen shaxsiga ugu weyn.
examples.note: Kana 'efficiency' waxay qoraal (lafaha -cy) oo ah Faransiiska 'eficiencia'. Gerundio 'improving' waxay u noqda inay noqoto iyo inay leedahay calaamad.

examples.original: The implementation of new policies requires careful planning.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv njuː ˈpɒlɪsiz rɪˈkwaɪəz ˈkeəfʊl ˈplænɪŋ
examples.translation: Tanciga siyaasadda cusub waxay u baahan tahay doorashada fiican.
examples.note: Eeg laba isku-ururinta: 'implementation' (qoraal lafaha -tion, sida Faransiiska) iyo 'planning' (gerundio). Isticmaalka 'of' Ingiriishiinta 'implementation of' waxay u dhaqmayaan 'de' Faransiiska.

examples.original: Understanding the issue requires examining all perspectives.
examples.phonetic: ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ ði ˈɪʃuː rɪˈkwaɪəz ɪɡˈzæmɪnɪŋ ɔːl pəˈspɛktɪvz
examples.translation: Fahamka xalaalka waxay u baahan tahay tijaabada waxyaalaha oo dhan.
examples.note: Silsilad gerundio: 'understanding' oo ah isagoo, 'examining' oo ah calaamad 'requires'. Faransiiska, laba waxay u tarjumaya isku-ururinta.

title: Ellipsis and Substitution (so do I, neither have we) / Ilkisiis iyo Badil
bridge: Faransiiska, waxaan u dhaqmaynaa inaan isku dhigo fiilka ama inaan isticmaalo 'been' iyo 'ma aha' sidii aan u adag yahay, waxaase inuu Ingiriishi ku isticmaalo fiil ka baxsan ama 'do/does/did' si loo diido isku dhigo. Miyirkaan wuxuu u muhiim ah inuu noqdo qalad iyo furan oo dhexdhexaad ah ee Ingiriishi, laakiin wuxuu u eg yahay sababtoo ah fiilka ka baxsan wuxuu la soo jeedaa waqtiga fiilka iyo qalabka jumlada asalkii. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Faransiiska ma jirto xaalad aan u adag la'aan ah 'so do I' ama 'neither have we', waxaase muujin in la qaado isku-badhtaminta aqoonka.
rule: Ilkisiiska iyo badilka Ingiriishi waxay u oggolaan in la diido macluumaad aan la hadlayo. Tijaabo qaansadood iyo jumalad 'so' iyo 'neither/nor', waxaa la isticmaalo fiil ka baxsan la soo jeeda dadka. Xaaladda fiilka waxay u adeegsan tahay waqtiga fiilka jumlada asalkii (had iyo jeer → do/does; dhibic weyn → did; waqtiga dhowrsan → have/has; qaybo → qaybtaas oo kale). Jumalada aad u jeclaan, waxaa la isticmaalo 'so + fiil + dadka' (e.g., 'So do I'). Jumalada aan jeclaan, waxaa la isticmaalo 'neither/nor + fiil + dadka' (e.g., 'Neither have we'). Waxaa jira si fiican oo kale 'do/does/did' meesha fiilka oo dhan (e.g., 'She speaks French better than I do'), iyo 'so' si loo diido xukun (e.g., 'I think so'). Ingiriishi rasmi ah, 'also' ama 'too' ma ay isticmaalina qaybo; fiilka waa in la qaado. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 'so' tijaabo aad u jeclaan, fiilka waa in la soo jeedo dadka tijaabada, ma aha dadka jumlada asalkii.

concept_examples.text: I love travelling, and so does my brother.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaa inaan u safarro, walaashana waa la isku jeclaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ˈtrævəlɪŋ ænd səʊ dʌz maɪ ˈbrʌðər/

concept_examples.text: We haven't finished the project, and neither have they.
concept_examples.translation: Ma nagu dhammayn projectka, iyaguna ma ay dhammayn.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi ˈhævənt ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ænd ˈnaɪðə hæv ðeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She didn't study for the exam, but I did.
concept_examples.translation: Iyada ma aqoonsan inay tijaabto imtixaanka, anigoo aqoonsan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdɪdnt ˈstʌdi fə ði ɪɡˈzæm bʌt aɪ dɪd/

concept_examples.text: I can speak three languages, and so can she.
concept_examples.translation: Lugu daro luqado, iyaduna waa la isku jeclaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ kən spiːk θriː ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz ænd səʊ kən ʃiː/

common_error.wrong: I like coffee, and also my friend likes.
common_error.correct: I like coffee, and so does my friend.
common_error.correct_alt: I like coffee, and my friend does too.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadada caadiga ah waxay ka soo baxaa tarjumaadka adag 'iyo walaalkayguna waa la isku jeclaa' ama 'iyo walaalkayguna waa la isku jeclaa'. Ingiriishi, markii la diido isku dhigo fiilka, fiil ka baxsan waa in la qaado 'so' (aad u jeclaan) ama 'too' dhexdhexaadka. 'Also' ma isticmaalina meeshaan, iyo inaan la isku dhigo fiilka 'like' ilaaliyaasha. Xusuusta waa in la ogaado fiilka u eg yahay waqtiga: 'like' (had iyo jeer) → 'does'.

examples.original: He has visited Paris, and so have I.
examples.phonetic: /hi hæz ˈvɪzɪtɪd ˈpærɪs ænd səʊ hæv aɪ/
examples.translation: Wuxuu boqday Paris, annaana waa la isku jeclaa.
examples.note: Isticmaalo 'have' waqtiga dhowrsan ah. Fiilka waa in la soo jeedo dadka.

examples.original: They will arrive early, and so will we.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl əˈraɪv ˈɜːli ænd səʊ wɪl wiː/
examples.translation: Waxay heli doonaan dhibic weyn, annagonna waa la isku jeclaa.
examples.note: Qaybo 'will', qaybtaas oo kale waxaa la isticmaalo tijaabada.

examples.original: She works hard, and so do I.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi wɜːks hɑːd ænd səʊ duː aɪ/
examples.translation: Waxay shaqeynaysaa natiijada, annaana waa la isku jeclaa.
examples.note: Had iyo jeer, isticmaalo 'do' dadka I/you/we/they, laakiin 'does' dadka he/she/it.

examples.original: We don't like spicy food, and neither does Mary.
examples.phonetic: /wi dəʊnt laɪk ˈspaɪsi fuːd ænd ˈnaɪðə dʌz ˈmeəri/
examples.translation: Ma nagu jeclaa cuntada daran, Maryna ma ay jeclaan.
examples.note: Markii jumlada asalkii ay noqoto aan jeclaan, isticmaalo 'neither' fiil aad u jeclaan (ma aha aan jeclaan).

examples.original: I can't swim, and nor can my sister.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kɑːnt swɪm ænd nɔː kən maɪ ˈsɪstə/
examples.translation: Ma aqoonsan inaan u dadaalo, walaashana ma ay aqoonsan.
examples.note: 'Nor' waa u adag 'neither' iyo isticmaalo qaybtaas oo kale.

examples.original: They haven't finished, and neither has he.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈhævənt ˈfɪnɪʃt ænd ˈnaɪðə hæz hiː/
examples.translation: Iyagu ma ay dhammayn, isaguna ma uu dhammayn.
examples.note: Waqtiga dhowrsan, isticmaalo 'has' dadka he/she/it iyo 'have' dadka kale.

examples.original: She speaks French better than I do.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi spiːks frenʃ ˈbɛtə ðən aɪ duː/
examples.translation: Waxay hadalaysa Faransiiska ugu fiican kisaa.
examples.note: 'Do' waxay badbixisaa fiilka 'speak' si loo diido isku dhigo.

examples.original: He didn't break the vase, but his brother did.
examples.phonetic: /hi ˈdɪdnt breɪk ðə vɑːz bʌt hɪz ˈbrʌðə dɪd/
examples.translation: Ma uu burburin jaranka, walaalkiisuna waa burburin.
examples.note: Dhibic weyn, isticmaalo 'did' si loo badbixo fiilka aan jeclaan ee horay.

examples.original: Do you think it will rain? - I think so.
examples.phonetic: /duː juː θɪŋk ɪt wɪl reɪn aɪ θɪŋk səʊ/
examples.translation: Ma aqoonsan inay soo jeedin? - Waxaan aqoonsan inay soo jeedin.
examples.note: 'So' waxaa la isticmaalo si loo badbixo xukun oo dhan ('it will rain') tijaabo.
